skills.name: Shift
skills.description: Self 8% Haste và Dodge trong 12s khi không có “Reverse Time”, stack đến 5 (max 40% Haste, Dodge)
usageNotes: Self 30% All Out trong 12s khi có “Reverse Time” (không thể làm mới) đồng thời tiêu hao “Reverse Time”
Enemy -15% Haste và Dodge trong 12s khi có “Reverse Time”
skills.officialDescription: Push time forward with your next strike dealing Light Damage to your opponent. Applies Push Time, increasing your Dodge and Haste by 8% for 12 seconds, stacks to 5. If Reverse Time is in play, Strike Blades will replace it with Temporal Blades increasing your Damage Output by 30% and applying Pull Time, lowering the opponent's Haste and Dodge by 15% for 12 seconds.
wikiNotes: Applies Push Time to caster for 12 seconds, increasing haste and dodge by 8% per stack, stacking to 5 (Note that haste stacking currently does not function, so haste will only be increased at most 8% from push time.).
If Reverse Time is active, applies Temporal Blades to caster for 12 seconds, increasing all damage dealt by caster by 30%. (Temporal Blades is not refreshed when re-applied).
If Reverse Time is active, applies Pull Time to enemy target for 12 seconds, lowering their Haste and Dodge Chance by 15%.
If Reverse Time is active, applies Overse Time to caster for 1 second, which removes Reverse Time.

combos.explanation: → Các trường hợp khác: 2 - 3 - 4 lặp lại đến khi nào có đủ 5 stack của skill 4 và 2. Tiếp theo 4 - 3 - 2 - 3 theo đúng thứ tự đến khi quái chết.
